name: Summarize specialized financial, political, and economic texts
description: Users asked to summarize specialized texts in finance, politics, economics, and law, often requesting specific character limits, condensed formats, or additional explanations of context and terminology. The requests varied from generating headlines and translating summaries to condensing long reports into brief key points.
